stem: Which sentence best states the main idea of the section titled “Old and New”?

options.label: A
options.text: They were made with any kind of wood that was available.

options.label: B
options.text: The shape of today’s baseball bats is also more regular — narrow at the handle and wide at the end.

options.label: C
options.text: Bats come in different lengths and weights.

options.label: D
options.text: Baseball bats have changed a great deal over the years.
